description: We are two developers and a media specialist turning complex NASA data into engaging, accessible learning tools. We're developing an educational platform that empowers students and space amateurs with real aerospace concepts, interactive tests, and practical practice. If you love science communication, UI/UX design, or astronomy, join our team and build this with us!
summary:
Artemis Odyssey is an interactive 3D space-exploration and mission-training game designed to help students understand the decisions behind operating on the Moon and Mars. Instead of presenting space science as static facts, it turns exploration into hands-on gameplay: players travel through a 3D Solar System, approach planetary destinations, guide a landing capsule through descent, operate a surface rover, investigate terrain, and interact with spacecraft and mission hardware.

The experience combines guided educational missions with open exploration. Mission objectives introduce a goal, while contextual controls and an in-game field notebook help players understand what they are doing and why it matters. Across scenarios, players encounter mission considerations such as electrical power, life support, radiation protection, environmental conditions, mobility, and communication. Some
details:
ARTEMIS ODYSSEY

Artemis Odyssey is an interactive 3D space exploration and educational mission-training game developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, specifically for the challenge "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer."

The project transforms space education into an interactive experience where players can explore the Solar System, experience spacecraft operations, guide landing capsules toward planetary surfaces, operate exploration rovers, and investigate different environments across the Moon and Mars.

The game combines guided educational missions with open exploration. Players can explore planets, interact with spacecraft and mission hardware, navigate planetary terrain, and complete objectives that introduce real space exploration concepts.

A key educational focus is understanding the challenges of sustaining human exploration beyond Earth. Artemis Odyssey introduces important mission systems and resources, including electrical power, life support, oxygen and water, radiation protection, environmental conditions, mobility, communication, and food production. These concepts help players understand why resource management and engineering decisions are essential for future lunar and Martian outposts.

The project also incorporates NASA resources to connect gameplay with real scientific information. NASA's DONKI provides space-weather event information, while NASA's Open Science Data Repository provides access to spaceflight life-science research. Additional NASA resources support planetary exploration, spacecraft references, and educational content.

The game distinguishes between REAL NASA DATA, SCIENTIFIC REFERENCE VALUES, and SIMULATED GAMEPLAY VALUES to avoid presenting simplified game mechanics as actual spacecraft telemetry.

TECHNOLOGY

The project is built using React 19, TypeScript, Three.js, Vite, Node.js, and Express. It also incorporates Google Gemini API functionality where enabled. PostgreSQL and Prisma are used in the broader application architecture. The source code is hosted on GitHub, and the game is deployed as a web application.

EDUCATIONAL IMPACT

Artemis Odyssey aims to make space science and engineering more accessible to students and young space enthusiasts. Through interactive exploration and guided scenarios, players can learn about planetary science, spacecraft systems, robotics, environmental challenges, and the complexity of establishing sustainable human outposts beyond Earth.

FUTURE DEVELOPMENT

Planned improvements include deeper lunar and Martian base management, more interactive resource-consumption systems, expanded life-support and food-production scenarios, additional rover experiments, and more detailed spacecraft hardware.

The long-term vision is to create an accessible educational space exploration platform that turns curiosity about the universe into an engaging, hands-on learning experience.
